subject: Error with initializing devices ahead of time

messages.author: ad42f9e518e6fe82
messages.subject: Error with initializing devices ahead of time
parts:
Hi group,

I'm new to GGIR and want to use to analyze our raw data (.gt3x) from ActiGraph GT9X+ collected in 7-day free-living. However, given the study flow, we usually initialized the device a week prior to the actual visit day and it started to collect data from then on. So, there was a bunch of "0,0,0" values to start with because the device sit in the dock for ~a week. Because of the large "0" issue, GGIR gives me the following error in Part 1:

Error in data_processed[which(is.na(data_processed[, j]) == TRUE), j] <- data_processed[p1[length(p1)],  :  replacement has length zero


I wonder if GGIR can somehow handle this issue with some external code? Or anyone has any available code to chop the data? Any insight would be helpful! 


Thanks a lot!


Susanna

messages.author: bec33d17cd9adcc8
messages.subject: Re: Error with initializing devices ahead of time
parts:
Hey Susanna

I am not an expert, but it seems to me that this issue can be resolved by using strategy = 3. Together with argument ndayswindow = 7, GGIR will detect the 7 most active days in your measurement period. See 
https://cran.r-project.org/web/packages/GGIR/vignettes/GGIRParameters.html (search for strategy and ndayswindow).

Cheers,
Pieter-Jan

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Re: Error with initializing devices ahead of time
parts:
Hi Susanna,

It sounds like the device collected a few data points a week prior to the recording then was asleep for a week and then started collected data, where ActiGraph imputed those data points with zeros.

For the time being could you try setting GGIR argument 'minloadcrit = 240'
this will tell GGIR to not attempt the auto-calibration before it has either reached the end of the file or has read at least 10 days of data.

If that does not work, could you sent me an example .gt3x file?

Thanks,

Vincent
